summary: Iteration 6 e2e (backend + frontend) for Dealer login/dashboard, Admin create-dealer-login modal, demo-friendly Masked Call, Nek Sathi brand rename, and regressions (owner-response loop, QR activation via email session, admin routes). Backend: 10/10 pytest passed. Frontend: 6/7 substantive checks PASS; 1 owner-response verification via public page reload was a flawed test mechanism (state re-derived from client memory, not URL) — admin incident history confirms coming-click DID flip the incident to status 'coming', so functionality is intact.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking alert-owner-btn the waiting screen (with call-owner-btn / owner-coming) is stored in local component state; reloading /scan/{qr_id} does not restore it. Not a bug for the demo (reporter is unlikely to reload), but consider persisting the last incident id in URL (e.g. /scan/{qr_id}?incident=...) or query the latest incident for that qr_id on load so refresh reflects owner-coming.

action_items: (Nice-to-have, not blocking demo) Persist last-incident-id on /scan/{qr_id} so a browser refresh preserves the waiting/owner-coming panel.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4017 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, vehicles, public, admin, dealer, incidents, telephony) for maintainability.

AdminDealers.jsx create-login testid uses raw vendor name (e.g. `create-login-Dealer B 79627`) containing spaces — works but selectors are fragile; consider slugified or id-based testids (`create-login-<vendor_id>`).
Masked call fallback correctly downgrades from Twilio-trial failure to status 'connecting' with no owner phone in response payload — verified.
Rate limits (login 10/min, incident 20/min, call 10/min) are appropriate; back-to-back automated test runs should either cache tokens or sleep to avoid 429s (tests updated accordingly).

success_rate.frontend: 6/7 substantive (masked-call, dealer-login+scoping, admin-create-dealer, new-dealer-login, brand, QR-activation, admin-regression PASS; owner-response public-page refresh check flawed test but admin history confirms coming did register)
